title: Calibrated Selective Referral for Skin Lesion AI on HAM10000
description: Final notebook reproducibility package for a leakage-controlled, calibrated, selective-referral HAM10000 skin-lesion AI workflow. The repository includes the authoritative Colab notebook, an auto-extracted audit script, reusable Python helpers, configuration files, lightweight tests, and publication-readiness documentation. Raw HAM10000/ISIC images, generated results, trained models, and deployment artifacts are intentionally excluded.
